question: Two is \(10\%\) of \(x\) and \(20\%\) of \(y.\) What is \(x - y?\)
solution:
To recover a whole from a known percentage of it, divide the given part by that percentage. Since \(10\%=\frac1{10}\) and \(20\%=\frac15\),
\[
x=2\div\frac1{10}=20,\qquad y=2\div\frac15=10.
\]
Therefore \(x-y=20-10=\boxed{10}\), choice \(\text{D}\).
